after:
Missing info; added as part of mapping project
CB 2026-11-05: Length changed from 50 to 37 mi. The 50 miles came from the December 2014 application. A May 2015 amendment dropped the H-313 line, about 14 miles of 24-inch pipe. EQM's results release for the third quarter of 2016 calls the line in service a 37-mile pipeline extension. Diameter changed from 24, 30 to 30, 16 inches. The September 2014 notice lists 30-inch pipe for the main line and a 0.6-mile 16-inch discharge line, and the May 2015 amendment says the dropped H-313 line was the 24-inch pipe. No source found gives the diameter as built. Capacity stays at 850 MMcf/d, the designed capacity in the May 2015 amendment. EQM's 2016 release also gives 650 MMcf/d, which is EQT's contracted firm capacity, not the line's capacity.
